<div class="pvme-exact-guide">
<h1 id="dragonkin-laboratory-basic" class="pvme-source-title"><nowiki>Dragonkin Laboratory Basic</nowiki></h1>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/EA7wP1w.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>ED2 is considered the most beginner friendly Elite Dungeon. The requirements to feasibly solo it both in terms of gear and skill are generally considered low. However, it still has considerable amount of challenging components which can result in fast KOs if the player is not careful.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Mechanics with high KO potential include but are not limited to:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Astellarn's neutron star</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Astellarn's black hole combined with celestial rain</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Verak Lith's fire tornados</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Verak Lith's egg bomb</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Black Stone Dragon's purple smoke/fire</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Black Stone Dragon's ability to attack semi-randomly using all 3 styles</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Black hands' heavy magic autos and small shadow hands</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Use zerker aura </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643505179378974748.png?v=1" alt="reckless" title="reckless" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643505153709965322.png?v=1" alt="mani" title="mani" kind="icon" /><nowiki> variants for the dungeon. Otherwise, </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643505653079343144.png?v=1" alt="vamp" title="vamp" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is fine for learning.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="Magic" title="Magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1" alt="range" title="range" kind="icon" /><nowiki> are used for this guide as </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1" alt="melee" title="melee" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is by far the least beginner friendly style to use in ED2.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="astellarn-the-first-celestial-info"><nowiki>Astellarn, the First Celestial (Info)</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/YzDTPVB5wy.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>The first boss you encounter. The boss has many mechanics that deal typeless damage so be prepared to eat. It uses hard hitting but slow auto attacks in all 3 styles, but primarily uses a </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="Magic" title="Magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> breath attack which is very easy to flick.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>

</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div style="background-color: rgb(0, 153, 255)"></div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>

</nowiki><div><u><nowiki>Mechanics</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><nowiki>

</nowiki><div><div><div><u><nowiki>Attack Rotation</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ Astellarn's starting attack pattern is:
    • 2-3 autos → Pulsar → ~2 autos → Black hole → 1-2 autos → Neutron Star → Repeat
​
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Celestial rain</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ When Astellarn falls below 200k HP, she starts taking drastically decreased damage and spawns celestial rain which affects a quadrant of the arena at any point of time, dealing rapid typeless damage which ramps up. </nowiki>[https://img.pvme.io/images/M6UbQli.mp4 <nowiki>Example</nowiki>]<nowiki>
    • Avoid standing in it always.
​
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Pulsar</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ Astellarn summons a pulsar with 20000 HP near you, dealing periodic typeless damage. Kill this as soon as possible once it spawns. </nowiki>[https://img.pvme.io/images/0UabHmn.mp4 <nowiki>Example</nowiki>]<nowiki>
    • Using basics together with a powerful threshold such as </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541270521708566.png?v=1" alt="rapid" title="rapid" kind="icon" /><nowiki> or </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1" alt="asphyx" title="asphyx" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to deal with it.
​
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Wyrmhole</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ Astellarn places a blue bar above your head. When it expires a black wyrmhole is dropped at the player location which deals rapid typeless damage. </nowiki>[https://img.pvme.io/images/ZVNJasC.mp4 <nowiki>Example</nowiki>]<nowiki>
    • Focus on placing it along these lines to prevent it from being blocked out by the later rain mechanic. </nowiki>[https://img.pvme.io/images/wlaz77A.jpg <nowiki>Example</nowiki>]<nowiki>
​
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Neutron Star</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ This will follow the player around and must be lured into the Wyrmhole, stabilizing it, turning white, and giving increased damage to Astellarn. </nowiki>[https://img.pvme.io/images/zHIuF3t.mp4 <nowiki>Example</nowiki>]<nowiki>
    • Do not let it touch you to avoid taking 4000+ damage.
        ⬩ Immediately teleport out and restart the fight if the star explodes like that.
    • The timing of this mechanic is not fixed so be extra careful of it and react accordingly.
​
</nowiki></div></div></div><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><nowiki>

</nowiki></div><nowiki>


</nowiki></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div>
<nowiki>

</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="astellarn-the-first-celestial-fight-tips"><nowiki>Astellarn, the First Celestial (Fight tips)</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Do not use your damage boosting ultimates </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921597813137518.png?v=1" alt="deathsswiftpf" title="deathsswiftpf" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921595489488927.png?v=1" alt="sunshinepf" title="sunshinepf" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, but instead igneous abilities </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/959089455283728386.png?v=1" alt="deadshotigneous" title="deadshotigneous" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/958989794757730307.png?v=1" alt="tsunamiincite" title="tsunamiincite" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and powerful thresholds for the first 50k HP.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921597813137518.png?v=1" alt="deathsswiftpf" title="deathsswiftpf" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921595489488927.png?v=1" alt="sunshinepf" title="sunshinepf" kind="icon" /><nowiki> after dropping the wyrmhole as you will deal most of your damage after luring the neutron star.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Stand out of her melee range so you only have to flick </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="Magic" title="Magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> autos.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ It is recommended to drop the wyrmhole between Astellarn and the west wall:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/t693lnb.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /><nowiki>
​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Keep hitting Astellarn before the Neutron Star spawns to build adren and as poison damage is unaffected by her damage reduction.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ You can </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1" alt="res" title="res" kind="icon" /><nowiki> or </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334377648130.png?v=1" alt="divert" title="divert" kind="icon" /><nowiki> after using </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921597813137518.png?v=1" alt="deathsswiftpf" title="deathsswiftpf" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921595489488927.png?v=1" alt="sunshinepf" title="sunshinepf" kind="icon" /><nowiki> while waiting for the Neutron Star to spawn.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ If you fail to lure the Neutron Star into the Wyrmhole, teleport out and restart the fight.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="verak-lith-info"><ins><nowiki>Verak Lith (Info)</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/A2EOjdXdyH.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Verak Lith is the second boss of the dungeon, he has sizeable HP and mechanics that can shred your HP if handled improperly. He uses heavy </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="Magic" title="Magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1" alt="melee" title="melee" kind="icon" /><nowiki> autos.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>

</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div style="background-color: rgb(0, 153, 255)"></div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>

</nowiki><div><u><nowiki>Mechanics</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><nowiki>

</nowiki><div><div><div><u><nowiki>Attack Rotation</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ Verak does the following attack rotation:
    • 4 Auto attacks → Spire → 4 Auto attacks → Ricochet → 4 Auto attacks → Spire → 4 Auto Attacks → Nosedive/Hurricanes → Repeat
​
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Spire</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ Verak Lith summons a spire with 15000 HP shortly after a warning message, dealing about 2000 melee damage to the player. </nowiki>[https://img.pvme.io/images/afn857t.mp4 <nowiki>Example</nowiki>]<nowiki>
​
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Ricochet</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ Verak sends out a projectile that lands near the player after a few seconds. The element of this projectile can be poison, ice, or shock. </nowiki>[https://img.pvme.io/images/1c5I5Ar.mp4 <nowiki>Example</nowiki>]<nowiki>
    • The correct way to deal with this mechanic is to pick up the projectile and interact with a different type of egg to disperse it before the bar fills up.
    • Missing the projectile will deal 4000 damage and missing the dispersal can deal 9000+ damage.
    • Players may want to miss the projectile and either </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541278264393729.png?v=1" alt="debil" title="debil" kind="icon" /><nowiki> or </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535614336207552523.png?v=1" alt="disrupt" title="disrupt" kind="icon" /><nowiki> it.
​
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Nosedive</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ A message will appear on the screen mentioning that a dragon is nosediving. An arrow will show up near the player to indicate the direction of approach. Shortly after, a thin line of dragonbreath will be fired along the line. </nowiki>[https://img.pvme.io/images/66ACLwS.mp4 <nowiki>Example</nowiki>]<nowiki>
    • This can deal over 8000 magic damage and can be avoided by simply moving out of the way. However, the arrow will adjust it's position based on the player's movement for a while so it is recommended to learn the timing on this mechanic and move as it goes off.
    • This can also be dealt with by using </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195487926845462.png?v=1" alt="DeflectMage" title="DeflectMage" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and tanking it.
​
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Hurricanes</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ Verak says 'Let the flames melt the flesh from your bones' and engulfs the area around the player in fire. This will deal no damage but after a short delay, hurricanes will spawn in the area that deal extremely high </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="Magic" title="Magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> damage, lasting for about 20 seconds. </nowiki>[https://img.pvme.io/images/uv37IW8.mp4 <nowiki>Example</nowiki>]<nowiki>
    • </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1" alt="surge" title="surge" kind="icon" /><nowiki> or run away from the area accordingly.
​
</nowiki></div></div></div><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><nowiki>

</nowiki></div><nowiki>


</nowiki></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div>
<nowiki>

</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="verak-lith-fight-tips"><nowiki>Verak Lith (Fight tips)</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Soulsplit </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615613924506599497.png?v=1" alt="soulsplit" title="soulsplit" kind="icon" /><nowiki> flicking is extremely recommended in this fight as it is quite long with Verak hitting you for moderately high damage consistently throughout.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ It is recommended to </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1" alt="res" title="res" kind="icon" /><nowiki> the hit from spires.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ You may place </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/662249620579155968.png?v=1" alt="dommine" title="dommine" kind="icon" /><nowiki> throughout the fight as they might explode on spires for 3000 damage each, allowing you to clear them extremely fast.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Rotation outline:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921595489488927.png?v=1" alt="sunshinepf" title="sunshinepf" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921597813137518.png?v=1" alt="deathsswiftpf" title="deathsswiftpf" kind="icon" /><nowiki> whenever possible.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• A threshold should be used to deal with each spire.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• In a </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921595489488927.png?v=1" alt="sunshinepf" title="sunshinepf" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, follow ability progression </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/958989794757730307.png?v=1" alt="tsunamiincite" title="tsunamiincite" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809978966037.png?v=1" alt="wm" title="wm" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1" alt="asphyx" title="asphyx" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1179505745654448208.png?v=1" alt="omnipowerigneous" title="omnipowerigneous" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833358016512.png?v=1" alt="deto" title="deto" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809978966037.png?v=1" alt="wm" title="wm" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1" alt="asphyx" title="asphyx" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• In a </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921597813137518.png?v=1" alt="deathsswiftpf" title="deathsswiftpf" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, follow ability progression </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535534127131394088.png?v=1" alt="snap" title="snap" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541270521708566.png?v=1" alt="rapid" title="rapid" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/642713547142332416.png?v=1" alt="shadowtend" title="shadowtend" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535534127131394088.png?v=1" alt="snap" title="snap" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541270521708566.png?v=1" alt="rapid" title="rapid" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/959089455283728386.png?v=1" alt="deadshotigneous" title="deadshotigneous" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="black-stone-dragon-info"><ins><nowiki>Black Stone Dragon (Info)</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/K6oQJBiYGF.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Black Stone Dragon is the final boss of ED2 and attacks using primarily slow </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="Magic" title="Magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> auto attacks, she can also use a fast </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1" alt="melee" title="melee" kind="icon" /><nowiki> bite or a spinning </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1" alt="range" title="range" kind="icon" /><nowiki> attack.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>

</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div style="background-color: rgb(0, 153, 255)"></div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>

</nowiki><div><u><nowiki>Mechanics</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><nowiki>

</nowiki><div><div><div><u><nowiki>650k-520k</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ BSD does the following attack rotation:
    • 3 Auto Attacks → Gemstone Spikes → 2 Auto Attacks → Dragonbreath → Repeat
​
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Gemstone Spikes</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ BSD fires a line of spikes, causing the screen to shake. A 3x3 zone of spikes erupts around the player's initial position after a short delay, dealing 5000+ melee damage, draining all adrenaline and applying a debuff that reduces all adrenaline gain by 50% for a short duration if it hits. </nowiki>[https://img.pvme.io/images/4ppYV4M.mp4 <nowiki>Example</nowiki>]<nowiki>
    • Move out of the way by at least 2 tiles.
​
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Dragonbreath</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ The skybox will turn dark blue and BSD fires a breath attack that deals moderate </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="Magic" title="Magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> damage.
    • You can pray </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195487926845462.png?v=1" alt="DeflectMage" title="DeflectMage" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to take less damage.
​
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Black Hands</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ When BSD falls below 520k HP, the black hands phase begins as she becomes invulnerable and BSD moves to the center of the arena, spawning 4 black hands with 80,000 hp where the rocks are located. </nowiki>[https://img.pvme.io/images/jBFHmJu.mp4 <nowiki>Example</nowiki>]<nowiki>
    • Clear them to continue the fight.
        ⬩ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/662249620579155968.png?v=1" alt="dommine" title="dommine" kind="icon" /><nowiki> help greatly as they explode for 10,000 damage each.
    • The hands attack by slamming down and sending out black smokes which hits for up to 4000+ magic damage upon impact. This is followed by a trail of small black hands which moves towards the player, dealing rapid 2000+ damage if stood on. </nowiki>[https://img.pvme.io/images/5MAYT2U.mp4 <nowiki>Example</nowiki>]<nowiki>
        ⬩ The small hands will never reach the player if they on any of these 4 spots. </nowiki>[https://img.pvme.io/images/Oa1qT6q.png <nowiki>Example</nowiki>]<nowiki>
​
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>520k-260k</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ BSD does the following attack rotation:
    • 1-5 Auto Attacks → Smoke Spiral → 3 Auto Attacks → Mage AoE → 2 Auto Attacks → Dragonbreath → Gemstone Spikes → 3 Auto Attacks → Mage AoE → Repeat
​
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Smoke Spiral</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ BSD remains stationary, summoning a line of purple smoke spirals inwards towards BSD, dealing up to 4000+ damage per tick if stood on. </nowiki>[https://img.pvme.io/images/ak3Y05T.mp4 <nowiki>Example</nowiki>]<nowiki>
    • Be aware when the smoke approaches your position and move out of the way if needed.
​
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Mage AoE</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ Black Stone Dragon will call out 'GET. OUT. OF. ME.' or 'The shadow overwhelms!' and turn to fire a black projectile towards a random spot. </nowiki>[https://img.pvme.io/images/UIpNtaq.mp4 <nowiki>Example</nowiki>]<nowiki>
    • The bomb explodes into black tendrils that deal heavy </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="Magic" title="Magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> damage in the area for a short period.
    • Move away to avoid it if needed.
​
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Fly</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ After BSD dips below 260k HP, she becomes invulnerable and starts jumping, landing randomly and spawning smoke lines towards the player every time she does, in addition to other zones of smoke.
    • This occurs 7 times before BSD says 'Show me the light' and becomes vulnerable again.
    • Move around as needed and use some abilities to build adrenaline on BSD and to avoid losing combat.
​
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>260k-0</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ BSD lands and immediately does a smoke spiral, following with the same post-smoke spiral attack rotation as 520k-260k.
​
</nowiki></div></div></div><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><nowiki>

</nowiki></div><nowiki>


</nowiki></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div>
<nowiki>

</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="blackstone-dragon-fight-tips"><nowiki>Blackstone dragon (Fight tips)</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Because her </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="Magic" title="Magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> autos are slow while her </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1" alt="melee" title="melee" kind="icon" /><nowiki> autos are fast, sometimes the hits can land at the same time and stack you out, you may use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1" alt="res" title="res" kind="icon" /><nowiki> or </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541278264393729.png?v=1" alt="debil" title="debil" kind="icon" /><nowiki> if you see this coming.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Rotation Outline:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921595489488927.png?v=1" alt="sunshinepf" title="sunshinepf" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921597813137518.png?v=1" alt="deathsswiftpf" title="deathsswiftpf" kind="icon" /><nowiki> at the start of the fight, and then whenever it comes back up until BSD flies.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921595489488927.png?v=1" alt="sunshinepf" title="sunshinepf" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921597813137518.png?v=1" alt="deathsswiftpf" title="deathsswiftpf" kind="icon" /><nowiki> on BSD again after flight and finish her off with powerful thresholds and abilities.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Black hands</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921595489488927.png?v=1" alt="sunshinepf" title="sunshinepf" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921597813137518.png?v=1" alt="deathsswiftpf" title="deathsswiftpf" kind="icon" /><nowiki> at the safespots during Black Hands to eliminate the need to move to avoid the small hands.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The default </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074235129858.png?v=1" alt="vulnbomb" title="vulnbomb" kind="icon" /><nowiki> option will help with applying </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074235129858.png?v=1" alt="vulnbomb" title="vulnbomb" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to Black Hands greatly.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Clear 2 Black Hands and then </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1" alt="surge" title="surge" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to the safespot between the other pair. </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921595489488927.png?v=1" alt="sunshinepf" title="sunshinepf" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921597813137518.png?v=1" alt="deathsswiftpf" title="deathsswiftpf" kind="icon" /><nowiki> once it comes off cooldown and finish off the other pair of hands.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ You may want to </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1" alt="res" title="res" kind="icon" /><nowiki> some hits from Black Hands.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/662249620579155968.png?v=1" alt="dommine" title="dommine" kind="icon" /><nowiki> as often as you can on hands. Pay attention to when they come off cooldown.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Flight phase</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If using </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="Magic" title="Magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, be sure to build or sustain </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/856635090783567902.png?v=1" alt="incitefear" title="incitefear" kind="icon" /><nowiki> or/and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/856635090745950258.png?v=1" alt="exsanguinate" title="exsanguinate" kind="icon" /><nowiki> stacks.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Don't stay on low health during flight to avoid randomly dying to smoke.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Remember to refresh </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/856635090641879050.png?v=1" alt="smokecloud" title="smokecloud" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074235129858.png?v=1" alt="vulnbomb" title="vulnbomb" kind="icon" /><nowiki> after BSD completes her flight phase.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Be ready to move from where you cast </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921595489488927.png?v=1" alt="sunshinepf" title="sunshinepf" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921597813137518.png?v=1" alt="deathsswiftpf" title="deathsswiftpf" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to avoid smoke.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="mobs-and-movement"><nowiki>Mobs and movement</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Mob clearing in ED2 is arguably the most tricky to do properly amongst the trilogy. There are various portions of the dungeon where you can be subjected to many sources of damage. Thus, using powerful abilities to clear and moving fast from place to place will benefit you greatly.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>

</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div style="background-color: rgb(0, 153, 255)"></div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>

</nowiki><div><nowiki>Monster mechanics
</nowiki></div><nowiki>

</nowiki><div><div><div><u><nowiki>Laboratory Slimes</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ Laboratory Slimes hitting you will spawn clone slimes (signified by 'Bloop'). </nowiki>[https://img.pvme.io/images/8wtfLrx.mp4 <nowiki>Example</nowiki>]<nowiki>
    • Pray </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488447201300.png?v=1" alt="DeflectMelee" title="DeflectMelee" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to avoid getting overwhelmed in the first room.
    • Clear the light-coloured slimes to open barriers, the darker-coloured clones being killed will not progress the dungeon. </nowiki>[https://img.pvme.io/images/RUfcGvO.png <nowiki>Example</nowiki>]<nowiki>
​
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Gemstone Dragons</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ All gemstone dragons standing not in melee distance can fire a gemstone spike special attack, dealing high magic damage and secondary effect depending on the type of dragon. </nowiki>[https://img.pvme.io/images/Rxkqxnf.mp4 <nowiki>Example</nowiki>]<nowiki>
    • Dragonstone dragon - Halves your antifire/super antifire duration.
    • Onyx dragon - Heals the dragon for 4000 HP.
    • Hydrix dragon - Instantly drains all adrenaline and applies a debuff that halves adrenaline for about 15 seconds.
    • Be careful of this especially when fighting multiple dragons.
    • Avoid these specs by stepping 2 tiles away from your original location before the spikes land.
​
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Celestial Dragons</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ Sometime after hitting below 36,000 HP, Celestial Dragons will start healing rapidly for 2400 HP each tick following a message. It will then repeat this every 6 auto attacks. </nowiki>[https://img.pvme.io/images/tITMd30.mp4 <nowiki>Example</nowiki>]<nowiki>
    • Stun or bind the dragon to stop the healing.
        ⬩ An easy way to do this is to click a </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074306301964.png?v=1" alt="stickybomb" title="stickybomb" kind="icon" /><nowiki> from your inventory when the dragon starts healing.
        ⬩ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641669268722810881.png?v=1" alt="mechchin" title="mechchin" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306563231790.png?v=1" alt="bindingshot" title="bindingshot" kind="icon" /><nowiki> or 4T </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400185245701.png?v=1" alt="icebarrage" title="icebarrage" kind="icon" /><nowiki> are good methods to bind several dragons at once.
​
</nowiki></div></div></div><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><nowiki>

</nowiki></div><nowiki>


</nowiki></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div>
<nowiki>

</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Beware of getting harassed by Lava Spiders from these areas:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153668820992.png?v=1" alt="bdmobile" title="bdmobile" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153798975498.png?v=1" alt="surgemobile" title="surgemobile" kind="icon" /><nowiki> while taking the path furthest away from them to avoid gaining aggression.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/M5GzLDc.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/ttzj2uX.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>

</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div style="background-color: rgb(0, 153, 255)"></div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>

</nowiki><div><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921434633744455.png?v=1" alt="deathsswift" title="deathsswift" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921119381463070.png?v=1" alt="sunshine" title="sunshine" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><u><nowiki>usage for clears</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><nowiki>

</nowiki><div><div><div><u><nowiki>Use them only in places with high concentrations of dragons</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ This includes but may not be limited to:
    • 7 Red Dragons at dungeon start </nowiki>[https://img.pvme.io/images/akGjAOJ.png <nowiki>Example</nowiki>]<nowiki>
    • 3 Celestial Dragons before Astellarn </nowiki>[https://img.pvme.io/images/wYkisYs.png <nowiki>Example</nowiki>]<nowiki>
    • 6 Black Dragons before Verak Lith </nowiki>[https://img.pvme.io/images/PeWyyBX.png <nowiki>Example</nowiki>]<nowiki>
    • 2 Lava Strykewyrms + 3 Black Dragons before Verak Lith </nowiki>[https://img.pvme.io/images/i4MpM6D.png <nowiki>Example</nowiki>]<nowiki>
    • 1 Onyx Dragon and 3 Dragonstone Dragons before BSD </nowiki>[https://img.pvme.io/images/W8YBfnl.png <nowiki>Example</nowiki>]<nowiki>
​
</nowiki></div></div></div><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><nowiki>

</nowiki></div><nowiki>


</nowiki></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div>
<nowiki>

</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ You may find the dragons in ED2 tricky to hit with AoE abilities, the table below sheds some light on this. For more information, refer to </nowiki><span><nowiki>#mechanics</nowiki></span><nowiki> (</nowiki><ins><strong><nowiki>NPC Center vs. Co-ordinate section</nowiki></strong></ins><nowiki>) or use </nowiki><code><nowiki>!chin</nowiki></code><nowiki> ‎command in </nowiki><span><nowiki>#bot-commands</nowiki></span><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>

</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div style="background-color: rgb(0, 153, 255)"></div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>

</nowiki><div><nowiki>AoE abilities on dragons
</nowiki></div><nowiki>

</nowiki><div><div><div><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833358016512.png?v=1" alt="deto" title="deto" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306391265284.png?v=1" alt="bombard" title="bombard" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258429661215.png?v=1" alt="incend" title="incend" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><u><nowiki>and anything affected by</nowiki></u><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641669268722810881.png?v=1" alt="mechchin" title="mechchin" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ If your main dragon target has another to their immediate south, west, or southwest, abilities will hit them. </nowiki>[https://img.pvme.io/images/M9XRIvs.png <nowiki>Example</nowiki>]<nowiki>
​
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/958989794757730307.png?v=1" alt="tsunamiincite" title="tsunamiincite" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><u><nowiki>and</nowiki></u><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833391702017.png?v=1" alt="dbreath" title="dbreath" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ Target a dragon further away and anything between you and the target will also be hit by the ability. </nowiki>[https://img.pvme.io/images/nBhbkE6.png <nowiki>Example</nowiki>]<nowiki>
​
</nowiki></div></div></div><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><nowiki>

</nowiki></div><nowiki>


</nowiki></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div>
<nowiki>

</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ You may find yourself eating a lot of damage from Lava Spiders and Laboratory Slimes.</nowiki></p>

</nowiki>

<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Lava Spiders after Astellarn will naturally get stuck behind Lava Strykes when you proceed to the Verak Lith boss fight:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/I7YK6hN.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /><nowiki>
 ‎‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• You can also teleport out at any time and re-enter the dungeon to despawn any non-essential mobs that are following you around.</nowiki></p>
